entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where no EMM context has been established, UE location is unknown to MME, and UE is unreachable by MME.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish an EMM context, initiated by UE from EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish an EMM context, initiated by UE from EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: No EMM context established
entities.description: Property indicating that no EMM context exists in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE unreachable by MME
entities.description: Property indicating UE location is unknown to MME and UE is unreachable in EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

relations.description: EMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes the property that no EMM context exists.
EMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes the property that UE is unreachable by MME.
UE starts attach procedure from EMM-DEREGISTERED state to establish EMM context.
UE starts combined attach procedure from EMM-DEREGISTERED state to establish EMM context.
